<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. I.||87}}</noinclude>{{c|{{xx-larger|THE HOLY GOSPEL}}}}
{{c|{{x-larger|OF IESVS CHRIST ACCOR-}}}}
{{c|{{larger|DING TO MARKE.}}}}

{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text={{sc|The first}} part of this Gospel: of the preparatiō to christs manifestation.}}{{c|{{larger|{{sc|Chap. I.}}}}}}

{{c|''Iohn (the Eremite of vvhom the Prophets) preaching penance, and liuing him self accordingly, baptizeth the people to prepare them to Christ, 7 telling them, that it is not his, but Christs Baptisme, in vvhich they shal receiue the Holy Ghost. 9 {{sc|Iesvs}} there is manifested from heauen: 12 and by and by he also goeth into the vvildernesse. 14 Beginning in Galilee, 16 after that he hath called foure Disciples, 21 he preacheth first in Capharnaum, confirming his doctrine vvith beneficial Miracles, to the great admiration of al: 35 then also (but first retiring into the vvildernes) in al the rest of Galilee, vvith like miracles.''}} {{dropinitial|T|fl={{verse|chapter=1|verse=1}}}}{{sc|He}} beginning of the Gospel of {{sc|Iesvs Christ}} the sonne of God. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=2}}† As it is vvritten in {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`the prophets''}}`Esay the Prophet', ''(Behold I send mine Angel before thy face, vvho shal prepare thy vvay before thee,)''{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mal. 3, 1.''}}{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Esa. 40, 3.''}} {{verse|chapter=1|verse=3}}† ''A voice of one crying in the desert, Prepare ye the vvay of our Lord, make straight his pathes''. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=4}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 3, 1. Lu. 3, 4. Io. 1, 15.''}}* Iohn vvas in the desert baptizing, and preaching the baptisme of penance {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Iohns baptisme put them in hope only of remissiō of sinnes as a preparatiue to Christes Sacrament by which sinnes were in deede to be remitted. ''Aug. li. 5 de bapt. c. 10''.}}∷ vnto remission of sinnes. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=5}}† And there vvent forth to him al the countrie of Ievvrie, and al they of Hierusalem: and vvere baptized of him in the riuer of Iordan, {{sup|‖}} confessing {{sup|‖}} their sinnes. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=6}}† And Iohn vvas {{sup|‖}} clothed vvith camels heare, and a girdle of a skinne about his loines: and he did eate locustes and vvild honie. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=7}}† And he preached, saying, There commeth a stronger then I after me: vvhose latchet of his shoes I am not vvorthie stouping dovvne to vnloose. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=8}}† I haue baptized you {{sup|‖}} vvith vvater: but he shal baptize you vvith the holy Ghost.

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=9}}† And it came to passe: in those daies came {{sc|Iesvs}} from Nazareth of Galilee: and vvas {{sup|‖}} baptized of Iohn in Iordan. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=10}}† And forthvvith comming vp out of the vvater, he savv the heauens opened, and {{sup|‖}} the Spirit as a doue descending, and remaining on him. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=11}}† And a voice vvas made from heauen, Thou art my beloued sonne, in thee I am vvel pleased.

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=12}}† And forthvvith {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 4, 1. Lu. 4, 1.''}}* the Spirit droue him out into {{sup|‖}} the {{hws|de|desert.}}<noinclude>{{rh|||sert.}}</noinclude>
